# KM-183 — Design: thread header, roster disclosure, header actions and detail pane

**Lane:** design · **Complexity:** 3 · **Model:** claude-opus · **Depends on:** KM-180, KM-135, KM-184 · **Serializes with:** KM-182 (both pass callbacks through `TimelineScreen`/`room.tsx`; land KM-182 first, or rebase), KM-134 (`room.tsx` and `mount.tsx` neighbours)
**Plan context (pinned):** [M1 plan](https://github.com/aiur-team/khala/blob/reset/m1-external-plan/docs/plans/2026-10-01-002-refactor-external-m1-thin-path-plan.md) · [contracts](https://github.com/aiur-team/khala/blob/reset/m1-external-plan/docs/build/m1/contracts.md) · [roster and graph](https://github.com/aiur-team/khala/blob/reset/m1-external-plan/docs/build/m1/roster.md) · **Design spec:** `docs/design/khala-chat/RECREATION-SPEC.md` §5, §6, §11, §12.3, §13.2, §22
**Exclusive write surfaces:**
- **Owned:** `apps/web/src/features/channel/{ChannelScreen.tsx,ChannelScreen.test.tsx,AgentPresencePanel.tsx,AgentPresencePanel.test.tsx,ChannelSharePanel.tsx,channel.css,channel.browser.spec.ts}`; `apps/web/src/ui/conversation/ParticipantDetail.tsx` + `detail.browser.spec.ts`; `apps/web/src/ui/khala/{header.css,detail.css,InvitePopover.tsx,AddAgentPopover.tsx}` + tests.
- **Render-prop wiring only:** `apps/web/src/composition/human/room.tsx`.

## Outcome

- **Header** (`reference/screens/fullbleed-1440-*-thread.png`): back button (≤900px), an overlapping avatar stack of up to 4 plus `+N`, the title with a chevron, the subtitle "You, Maya, Kai · **3 humans · 6 agents**" in green, and an Invite header action (there is no Settings gear in M1).
- **Roster** (`…-roster.png`): a disclosure that overlays the thread. It shows a human → agents tree with harness logos, owner badges, and a listening-mode segment for the viewer's agents, disabled in M1. The viewer's row has an Add agent action.
- **Detail pane** (`…-detail-agent.png`, `…-detail-human.png`): it opens from any avatar, name, mention, roster row or event. It holds the hero, the owner pill, "Recent in Khala", `@ Mention`, and Rename for the viewer's own agents.
- **Popovers** (`…-pop-invite.png`, `…-pop-add-agent.png`): Invite shows the live link plus disabled M2 options. Add agent copies the channel link.

## Scope

1. **Header** (§5): the DOM and the verbatim CSS go in `ui/khala/header.css`.
   - **Stack:** non-viewer members in member order, as `Avatar` buttons that open detail, with `+N` beyond 4.
   - **Subtitle:** the plural rules in §5.
   - **Title:** a visually hidden `<h1>` with the title, rendered once in `.kh-main`.
   - **Header button:** `aria-controls="kh-roster"`.
   - **Back:** `.kh-back` calls `onBack`, which navigates to the list route.
   - Delete the `<details class="channel-roster">`, `ChannelParticipants` chips and toolbar portal.
2. **Roster** (§6.1–§6.3), in M1 form (§22):
   - **Groups:** the viewer first, then other humans in member order. Each agent sits under its owner, matched by `ownerId`. An agent whose owner is not a member goes under a synthetic group with `<em>Not in this channel</em>`.
   - **`.kh-rh em`:** "Owner of N agent(s)". The design shows role · host, which we don't have. **No crown** in M1.
   - **`.kh-rai`:** the static avatar, then `<b>{label}{optional .kh-id}</b><em>{harness name: "Claude Code" | "Codex"}</em>`. **No** `.kh-rai-p` (progress is [M2]) and **no** `.kh-st` (connection is `unknown`).
   - **The viewer's agents:** `.kh-seg.ic` with Steer/Sync/Async icons, `aria-checked` on Sync, every button `disabled`, `title="Coming soon"` and the class `lock`. Keep `data-tip` with the verbatim mode tips. Add `.kh-mode-btn` for container widths ≤520px. **Do not** open the mode menu.
   - **Other agents:** `.kh-mode-ro` with the sync icon and tip "Sync · next turn".
   - **The viewer's row:** `.kh-racts` → `button.kh-ib.sm` (agent icon, tip "Add agent", `aria-expanded`) → the Add agent popover.
   - **Omit:** Requests, the header badge, kebabs and `.kh-confirm` (all [M2]).
   - **Behaviour:** `--kh-head-h` and `--kh-roster-max` on `.kh-main` (§6.3, with a ResizeObserver); the `.more` fade; a thread click closes the roster; Escape closes it and returns focus; `inert` while closed. Opening the roster closes the chips grid via the `onRosterOpen` callback (KM-184 exposes `closeChips()`).
3. **Header actions** (`.kh-hacts`):
   - **Invite:** `.kh-ib` (share icon, tip "Invite") opens the **Invite popover** (§12.3, M1 column).
     - Live link row: `ChannelSharePanel`'s link logic, refactored into a hook `useChannelLink(admission, channelLinks, roomId)` in the same file. The copy button toasts "Copied", or shows a fallback `.kh-txt` to select by hand on copy failure (keep `ChannelSharePanel.tsx` behaviour).
     - Type: `.kh-seg.lock`, "Open" on, disabled.
     - Approve joins: `.kh-sw` `aria-checked="false"` disabled.
     - History: `.kh-lk` label with the lock icon, tip "Humans see messages from when they join", `.kh-seg.lock` with "From join" on.
     - Every disabled control has `title="Coming soon"`.
     - Show Invite only when `renderShare` is available (admin path, R2).
   - **No Settings gear** in M1 (§22).
4. **Add agent popover:** `.kh-pop-h` "Add agent", then `button.kh-btn.pri.kh-btn-ic` (copy icon) "Copy link", then `span.kh-hint` "paste into your agent". It copies the same channel link (C7 `khala_join` input) and toasts "Copied".
5. **Detail pane** (§11), from `ParticipantDetail`, keeping its focus-trap and overlay logic:
   - **Human:**
     - hero: a 64px `.kh-hav`, the name, and `<span>Owner of N agents</span>`
     - `.kh-d-sec` "Agents · N" listing `.kh-d-agent` rows (`role="button" tabindex="0"`, static avatar, `<b>label</b><em>harness</em>`, **no %**)
     - "Recent in Khala": the last 3 loaded messages by this participant, newest first, as `<time>h:mm</time><span>{rendered text}</span>`
     - `@ Mention {first name}` as `.pri` (omitted for the viewer)
   - **Agent:**
     - hero avatar, `<b>{label}{optional .kh-id}</b>`, `<span>{Claude Code|Codex}</span>`
     - `.kh-d-owner`: `<i>{INI}</i><span>Owned by <b>{ownerLabel}</b></span>`, or `<span>Your agent</span>` for the viewer's own; clicking it opens the owner's detail
     - `.kh-d-sec` holding `dl.kh-d-kv` with `Harness`, `Owner` and `Joined` (`h:mm`, or `dayLabel` if not today)
     - "Recent in Khala"
     - `.kh-d-act`: `@ Mention` as `.pri`
     - for the viewer's own agent, a `.kh-d-sec` "Rename" built from today's rename flow (the `renameAgent` prop at `room.tsx:454-463` and the rename UI in `AgentPresencePanel.tsx`), restyled with `.kh-txt` + `.kh-btn`
     - **Omit** Working on, the Epic/Phase/Status/Runtime/Progress rows and Open ticket
   - **Openers:** avatars, names, mentions (KM-182's `onOpenParticipant`), roster rows, the owner pill and events.
   - Re-selecting the open participant closes the pane.
   - The pane closes when that participant leaves.
   - Apply the D3/D4/D5 fixes (§11 CSS).
6. `@ Mention` inserts `@{label} ` through KM-184's `insertMention(label)`.
7. Delete the superseded CSS in `features/channel/channel.css:3-54,114-211`, keeping only what this ticket still uses.

## Non-goals

- Thread rows and mention parsing: **KM-182**.
- Chips and composer: **KM-184**.
- List: **KM-181**.
- Shell and primitives: **KM-180**.
- Requests and approvals, remove member or agent, delete or leave channel, listening-mode changes, progress, status dots, admin crown, the Settings popover: [M2], omitted (§22).
- The `.kh-ask` adoption chip: [M2]; the confirm page is **KM-134**/**KM-185**.

## Contract and invariants

C3 (contracts.md, quoted):

```ts
export type AgentOwnerRecord = { matrixUserId: string; ownerId: string; ownerLabel: string; harness: Harness; label: string; createdAt: string };
```

C7 `khala_join` input `{ link: string, label?: string }`. The Add agent link **is** the channel link the agent passes as `link`.

R2 (M1 plan): "The admin can copy a channel link. In M1 only the admin creates links."

## Implementation pointers (refreshable @ 5db209cc)

### Files

**Create:**
- `ui/khala/{InvitePopover.tsx,InvitePopover.test.tsx,AddAgentPopover.tsx,AddAgentPopover.test.tsx}`
- `features/channel/roster-model.ts` + `roster-model.test.ts` (pure grouping)

**Modify:** the files listed in **Exclusive write surfaces**.

**Delete:** `ChannelParticipants`, the `channel-roster*`/`channel-participants*`/`channel-toolbar*` CSS, and `.agent-presence__*` styles no longer rendered.

### Worked example

`roster-model.groupRoster({ viewer:{participantId:'p-me',ownerId:'o-me',displayName:'Kevin'}, humans:[{participantId:'p-maya',ownerId:'o-maya',displayName:'Maya Chen'}], agents:[{participantId:'a1',ownerId:'o-me',displayName:'Claude · Kevin',harness:'claude'},{participantId:'a2',ownerId:'o-maya',displayName:'Codex · Maya',harness:'codex'},{participantId:'a3',ownerId:'o-zed',displayName:'Claude · Zed',harness:'claude'}] })` →

```ts
[ { human: viewer, isViewer: true,  agents: [a1] },
  { human: maya,   isViewer: false, agents: [a2] },
  { human: { displayName: 'Zed', ownerId: 'o-zed' }, notInChannel: true, agents: [a3] } ]
```

The rendered viewer agent row:

```html
<div class="kh-rrow"><button type="button" class="kh-rai" data-kh-agent="a1"><span class="kh-av" style="--h:210"><img src="…claude-symbol.svg" alt=""><span class="kh-own" style="--oh:214">KE</span></span><span><b>Claude</b><em>Claude Code</em></span></button>
<span class="kh-racts"><span class="kh-seg ic lock" role="radiogroup"><button role="radio" aria-checked="false" disabled title="Coming soon" data-tip="Steer · interrupts" aria-label="Steer · interrupts">…steer…</button><button role="radio" aria-checked="true" class="on" disabled …>…sync…</button><button role="radio" aria-checked="false" disabled …>…async…</button></span></span></div>
```

### Steps

1. `roster-model.ts` with tests.
2. Build the header in `ChannelScreen.tsx` and the CSS.
3. Build the roster. Move the rename UI out of `AgentPresencePanel` into the agent detail section. `AgentPresencePanel` either becomes the roster renderer or is deleted. Keep exported names stable or update `package.json` `exports` (`apps/web/package.json` `./features/channel/AgentPresencePanel`) if the file is deleted.
4. Build `InvitePopover` (with `useChannelLink`) and `AddAgentPopover` on KM-180's `Popover`.
5. Restyle `ParticipantDetail` to §11, with the human and agent variants. Wire the openers through `room.tsx` render props.
6. Clean up the CSS. Compare with `reference/screens/fullbleed-{1440,390}-{dark,light}-{roster,detail-agent,detail-human,pop-invite,pop-add-agent}.png`.

## Test scenarios

- `features/channel/roster-model.test.ts`:
  1. The worked example above.
  2. A human with no agents → no `.kh-ra`.
  3. A viewer with no agents → still first.
- `features/channel/ChannelScreen.test.tsx`:
  1. The stack shows 4 avatars plus `+2` for 6 others.
  2. The subtitle reads `You, Maya · 2 humans · 1 agent`.
  3. The header button toggles `aria-expanded` and `.roster-open`.
  4. Escape closes the roster and focuses the header button.
  5. A click in the thread closes the roster.
  6. The viewer's agent row has 3 disabled radios, with Sync checked.
  7. Another person's agent row has `.kh-mode-ro`.
  8. There is no kebab, Requests group or crown.
- `ui/khala/InvitePopover.test.tsx`:
  1. The link appears once loaded, and Copy toasts "Copied".
  2. Type, Approve and History are disabled with `title="Coming soon"`.
  3. On copy failure, the fallback input is focused and selected.
- `ui/khala/AddAgentPopover.test.tsx`: Copy link writes the channel link to the clipboard.
- `ui/conversation/detail.browser.spec.ts` (update the existing spec):
  1. At 760px, detail is a dialog that traps focus, and Escape restores focus (keep).
  2. At 1440px it is `complementary` and non-modal (keep).
  3. At 390px, no strip of `.kh-detail` is visible while closed (D2).
  4. The owner pill text is `.78rem` (D3).
  5. A `.kh-d-agent` avatar is 32×32 (D5).

## Verification

- `pnpm --filter @khala/web test`
- `pnpm --filter @khala/web test:browser`
- `pnpm typecheck`

**Done when:** the header, roster, popovers and detail match the references at 1440 and 390 in both themes. Every §22 "Omit" element is absent and every "Disabled" element has `disabled` and `title="Coming soon"`.

## Risks and stop conditions

- If `renderShare`/`admission` is absent for a member, which is expected for non-admins, hide Invite. Do not add a fallback link source.
- If the rename flow cannot move without changing `room.tsx` beyond render props, stop and ask the Executor.

## Complexity rationale

3: three surfaces (header, roster, detail) plus two popovers, a migration of the rename UI, and focus management.
